edition.title: Enarrationes in XII Psalmos Davidicos as printed in Patrologia Latina 14

work.author: Ambrose of Milan
work.description: Ambrose's surviving expositions of twelve psalms: 1, 35-40, 43, 45, 47, 48 and 61. The collection is not a commentary on the whole Psalter, and an absence from it is an absence from those twelve psalms only. Of the four psalms appointed in the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost only Vulgate Psalm 39, the Offertory's, is expounded here; Psalms 85, 91 and 94 are not in the collection at all. A locus is Vulgate psalm number followed by the numbered section.
work.title: Enarrationes in XII Psalmos Davidicos
